description: This file defines the 'Permission' controller for the Coocook web application, handling project permission management including listing, adding, editing, making owners, and revoking permissions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Permission
classes.description: Controller class managing project permissions in the Coocook application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of permissions for a project, including organization and user permissions, with options to edit, revoke, or transfer ownership.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding new permissions to a project for organizations or users based on submitted parameters.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to load and verify permission objects based on user input, used as a common setup for other actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Updates the role of an existing permission.

methods.name: make_owner
methods.description: Transfers project ownership to a specified permission entity.

methods.name: revoke
methods.description: Revokes (deletes) a permission from a project.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the permissions index page after an action.
